blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon flight typically lasting about an hour, with total time around three hours including meet-up. Flights are offered in the morning before sunrise or in the evening for stable air conditions. The company operates licensed and insured balloons with experienced pilots and offers private and shared flights.
